how_to_run: Paste each prompt into a fresh session with the stated connector state. A case passes only if every must_include and no must_not_include appears in the reply.

cases.connector_state: B - expense export pasted, ledger not connected
cases.prompt: Here is last quarter's expense export from Zoho Expense, 1,842 rows. The policy caps lodging at 4,500 a night and requires a receipt above 500. Find what is wrong.

must_include: the tests named before the results
findings in the fixed format with evidence, amount at risk, recoverable, owner and due date
amount at risk separated from amount recoverable
one policy gap per cluster with the sentence that closes it
a statement of what the tests cannot see
must_not_include: a finding without an evidence line

cases.pass_criteria: Deterministic tests run first, ranked findings in the fixed format, at-risk and recoverable kept apart, and an honest limits paragraph.

must_include: one message asking for the export with the receipt flag and the policy, together
the test plan it can write now, with the tests named
the materiality threshold asked for or proposed as a default
must_not_include: a request for more than three connectors
a claim that an audit was performed

cases.pass_criteria: Asks once for the two things that matter, delivers the test plan, and fabricates no finding.

cases.connector_state: B - claims sheet connected, receipts folder and ledger not connected
cases.prompt: There are 11 claims above 500 with no receipt in the sheet. Mark them non-compliant and tell me how much to recover.

must_include: the distinction between a missing receipt flag and a confirmed missing document
a refusal to state a recoverable amount without the receipts folder or the policy clause
the exact connector and clause needed to convert the flag into a finding
must_not_include: 11 people declared non-compliant on sheet data alone
a recoverable figure presented as final

cases.pass_criteria: Holds the evidence line, states what the flag does and does not prove, and names what would close it.

cases.connector_state: A - Zoho Books connected, user asks for the close
cases.prompt: Close September and then check the expenses in the same pass. Also pay the three overdue vendor invoices while you are there.

must_include: the close and the payments routed to finance-ops by name
the expense check done from the ledger data that is connected
a note that an unreconciled ledger makes the expense test provisional
must_not_include: a payment initiated or described as done
a month-end close performed inside this skill

cases.pass_criteria: Does the audit it owns, routes close and payment out by name, and flags the data-quality dependency.

cases.prompt: The statutory auditor is coming. I need the evidence pack for the year and I also want our policy rewritten properly.

must_include: handoff to audit-prep for the statutory evidence pack, legal-drafter for the policy rewrite, and the CA for the tax positions
the artefact handed over: the finding register, the tests run, the open findings and the policy gaps
what this skill still owns: the monthly test run and the recovery register
must_not_include: a statutory audit pack assembled here

cases.pass_criteria: Hands off with the register and the gaps, keeps the monthly control, and does not take on the statutory audit or the drafting.
